ITEM 1 | Breaded fried piece, golden-brown to dark reddish-brown crust with rough, craggy, crumb-like surface and some darker spots, irregular chunk about 8 x 6 cm, sitting at upper-left of plate with a flatter section under it | 110
ITEM 2 | Breaded fried piece, golden-brown crust with rough, bumpy texture and a whitish inner edge visible, wedge-shaped portion about 9 x 5 cm, overlapping the lower-left of the plate beside the slaw | 120
ITEM 3 | Shredded coleslaw-style mix of pale green and white cabbage shreds with thin orange carrot strands and small flecks of green herb, moist with slight dressing sheen, mound about 7 x 5 cm and about 1.5 cm tall, resting on and beside the fried pieces | 60
ITEM 4 | Strips of cooked bacon, glossy reddish-brown with darker caramelized edges, slightly curled and limp, two pieces together about 12 x 4 cm and under 0.5 cm thick, lying on the right side of the plate | 35
ITEM 5 | Scattered small dark brown crumbs, a few fragments about 0.5 cm each, dry and matte, sitting on the plate near the top of the breaded piece | 2
